issues.summary: 9 new F040 BLOCKERs: test.skip( in Batch 19 Playwright E2E specs. tools/lint_frontend_conventions.py treats test.skip in a Playwright spec as a BLOCKER because E2E specs cover MUST requirements and may not be skipped. Affected: web/tests/e2e/rnd-ui-05.rate-limit-backpressure.e2e.spec.ts lines 58, 84, 106, 136, 145, 171; web/tests/e2e/rnd-ui-06.conflict-resolver.e2e.spec.ts line 278; web/tests/e2e/a11y-gate.e2e.spec.ts lines 97, 171.
issues.evidence: main run 31736196943 Frontend conventions: 166 files checked, BLOCKER=6 (all F020, inherited). PR run 31743511656 Frontend conventions: 188 files checked, BLOCKER=15. Delta = 9 F040, all in Batch 19 specs.
issues.note: The a11y-gate skips are the mechanism by which GRD-UI-06's axe-core scan was marked DEFERRED to WF-05 UAT — resolving this issue requires a policy decision on how a deferred MUST-requirement gate is expressed without test.skip, not merely a code edit.

issues.summary: Step 05 RELEASE-VALIDATOR approved the batch without running tools/lint_frontend_conventions.py, so the F040 violations were not detected at the release gate. The Step 05 criterion set covers pnpm type-check / lint / vitest / build but not the repo's own frontend-conventions linter, which CI does enforce.
issues.note: Recommend adding lint_frontend_conventions.py to the RELEASE-VALIDATOR criterion set for frontend batches.
